title: Execute Senshac legacy-to-modular cutover
description: Epic for completing the migration from archived NacoSolutions/senshac to the modular Senshac repositories. Every Warren run must be created against exactly one open Seeds item from this epic or a child task, and the run must report that tracker ID in its PR and final status. Work proceeds in bounded PRs with one owner repository, explicit acceptance criteria, cost cap, and green quality gates. Sequence: migrate web application; integrate content and Tina editorial model; validate media/R2 and platform infrastructure; run route/SEO/accessibility/performance/rollback acceptance; then promote and begin redesign. Archived senshac remains the rollback source until acceptance is complete.

title: Build minimal senshac-ci OCI image
description: Create the first tailored Senshac OCI image in senshac-infra using Nix dockerTools. Focus on reducing CI image size and startup/pull time without sacrificing deterministic builds. Inventory current CI dependencies and baseline image size/startup first; build a minimal non-root senshac-ci image from Nix closures with no Dockerfile or distro base; preserve Flox for local tooling; add reproducible build, smoke, UID, closure-size, and forbidden-base checks; document build/cache/publish usage and record before/after size and timing. Keep senshac-agent, senshac-media, and senshac-warren out of scope except for shared builder conventions. Acceptance: nix flake check passes; image builds through the documented command; image runs the CI entrypoint as non-root; no credentials are embedded; image size and cache behavior are measured; focused PR and rollback notes are recorded.
